items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Jay McShann; Interviewee responds to general comments about musicians' habits ('Yeah, lazy.') without claiming a personal relationship or specific interaction with McShann.

ctx.x: Taddy Smith. And Clarence Williamson, fiddler. He was --
Yeah, I just saw him in Europe.

items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And then, that's when these fellows, Je ter and Pillars came through Columbus.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played with Jonah Jones for a long time. And they had another piano player around there named Pickett, he married the chi-chi girl, Rose Murphy. He was a fantastic player. He died. He was a good piano player. They all used to play together around there, you know. And this -- my mother came and got me and made me go back to Columbus and finish school.
And then, that's when these fellows, Je ter and Pillars came through Columbus. And --
Where did they come from, St. Louis?
